messages:
rachael: follow-up from last night's postmortem - recurring pages during the quiet window from the backfill job. want owners, short fixes, and verification plan.

diego: i'll take the alert tuning. current: instant count over 1m -> fires on transient spikes. plan: move to 10m rolling avg + require two consecutive windows. add a post-deploy suppression for tagged releases. aiming to open PR by Tue EOD.

priya: i'll own dedupe and routing. propose dedupe_key: job_name:region and route to `oncall-low` rota for scheduled windows. also add a label `scheduled_backfill=true` so dashboards filter. PR target: Thu.

sam: ops action - add a runbook quick-action on the alert (cancel backfill, pause schedule), and a short checklist for oncall to validate whether suppression should be bypassed. ETA: 5 business days.

ops-bot: incident 2901234567 resolved by rachael — duration 58m — postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2901234567 (auto)

rachael: acceptance criteria suggestion: 14-day rolling reduction >= 75% in pages during the quiet window and at least one documented escalation test (manual cancel) in runbook. owners must attach dashboard screenshots to close.

diego: config snippet i'll add to the PR:
```yaml
alert: backfill-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(10m) > 0.04
require: 2_consecutive_windows
suppression:
  when_tag: release=true
  window: 20m
correlation_bypass:
  - service: db-error-rate
    threshold: 0.02
dedupe_key: "job_name:region"
```

priya: routing snippet -> `route: oncall-low-priority` and label `scheduled_backfill=true`. i'll validate in staging that pages appear only on the low rota.

sam: runbook note: include cancel command, recovery checklist, and 'bypass suppression' step if correlated db alert is firing. will add a one-click link in the alert card.

rachael: timeline recap - diego PR Tue, priya PR Thu, sam runbook in 5d. checkpoint next Monday 10am to review results. /remind @ops-team checkpoint next_monday 10:00

diego: will include pre/post fire counts and synthetic test that simulates backlog.

priya: staging test running now, will post results here.

oncall-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-30 10:00 (auto)
